blocks.text: It is reported that the pagans offered to worship Allah alone for one year, *provided that the Prophet (* صلى الله عليه وسلم *) worshipped their multiple gods for a year.* *So this Meccan sûrah was revealed, telling them that he (* صلى الله عليه وسلم *) will be* *dedicated only to the worship of Allah until the last breath of his life, which* is the highlight of the next sûrah.
In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful
I do not worship what you worship,
nor do you worship what I worship.
I will never worship what you worship,
nor will you ever worship what I worship.
You have your way, and I have my Way.”
